3.t: And when the hills are moved,

4.t: And when the camels big with young are abandoned,

5.t: And when the wild beasts are herded together,

8.t: And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked

9.t: For what sin she was slain,

10.t: And when the pages are laid open,

11.t: And when the sky is torn away,

13.t: And when the Garden is brought nigh,

14.t: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready.

15.t: Oh, but I call to witness the planets,

16.t: The stars which rise and set,

19.t: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger,

20.t: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,

22.t: And your comrade is not mad.

23.t: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.

24.t: And he is not avid of the Unseen.

25.t: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned.

27.t: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,

28.t: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.

29.t: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.
